data.one_liner: Transport-agnostic RPC framework for Dart with streaming and zero-copy in-process transport.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart RPC framework that can run over any transport, including in-process, WebSocket, HTTP/1.1, and HTTP/2 with gRPC wire protocol. It supports unary, server, client, and bidirectional streaming, resilience features, and optional code generation for boilerplate.
use_when: Building cross-platform RPC services that need to run over multiple transports
Implementing streaming RPC calls with flow control
Requiring zero-copy in-process communication for performance
avoid_when: You only need a simple HTTP client or REST wrapper
Your project already uses a dedicated gRPC library and you don't need the extra abstraction
strengths: Zero-copy in-process transport for high performance
Built-in streaming support with flow control
Resilience features like retry, circuit breaker, rate limiting
Pure Dart implementation with no native dependencies
weaknesses: Requires understanding of RPC concepts and transport setup
No built-in UI or higher-level abstractions
data.setup_notes: Add rpc_dart to pubspec, import package:rpc_dart/rpc_dart.dart, no build_runner needed unless using rpc_dart_generator
